prompt: Looking straight down from directly above at a plain white enamel camping mug of tea resting on a mossy grey rock, the same rock and moss as in the garden picture. The mug sits exactly in the centre of the picture and fills about half its width; its round white rim is a clean, even circle, and the tea inside is milky brown, perfectly still, a faint curl of steam. Around it, moss, a few fallen leaves and grass at the edges. Soft, even late-afternoon daylight, no harsh shadows, calm and quiet. No hands, no people, no words or logos anywhere.
